name: Éirinn
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Éirinn appears as a name in Irish tradition. She appears as the parent of Ériu, Banba, and Fódla, the goddesses who stand for the Irish land. The name Éirinn comes from the name of Ériu. Ériu carries the title for the whole island. This link suggests a poetic tradition. It is not a genuine myth.

attributes.attribute: given as the mother of the three land goddesses
name formed from that of Ériu

okr.objective: Éirinn is an Irish figure tied to the three land goddesses.
key_results: Some texts give this name to the mother of Ériu, Banba, and Fódla.
